Unite Pro 1.6
July 26, 2026
Download Unite Pro 1.6

  • 1Password Autofill (Beta): A new "Fill passwords from" option in Settings > Passwords lets Unite apps fill your logins straight from 1Password, alongside the built-in password manager.

  • VoiceOver Support: Added proper VoiceOver labels throughout Unite and your generated apps, including settings dialogs, so screen reader users can navigate every control.

  • Faster Typing on ChatGPT and Similar Sites: Fixed several background inefficiencies that were slowing down typing and streaming responses in ChatGPT-style apps compared to Safari or Chrome.

  • Local File App Support: You can now create apps that point to local files, not just web addresses.

  • Popup Tab Fix: Fixed tabs opened by a site (via "open in new tab" links) becoming unresponsive or stuck open after a while.

  • Favicon Notification Badge Fix: Fixed tab favicons and pinned tab titles getting stuck showing an old notification count — like a tab still showing "11" long after you'd already cleared your notifications on the site.

  • Link-Launch Improvements: Fixed launching an app from a link also opening an extra home page tab, added a setting to control this ("Don't open home page when launched from a link"), fixed "Move to New Window" ignoring the current page, and fixed sidebar windows showing the app name instead of the page title until switching modes.

  • Smarter Default Browser Forwarding: "Forward to default browser" now always follows your current macOS default browser, instead of getting stuck on whichever browser was default when you first turned the setting on.

  • Whitelist Wildcard Fix: Fixed whitelist patterns with wildcards (like 192.168.0.* or *://github.com/*) not matching as expected.

Unite Pro 1.5
June 18, 2026
Download Unite Pro 1.5

  • Improved Media Key Support: Media controls now continue working on many more websites, even when the page is hidden or running in the background.

  • Improved Fullscreen Video Playback: Fixed issues where fullscreen playback was not working correctly in YouTube playlists and Netflix.

  • External App Link Improvements: Improved support for links that open native apps through custom URL schemes, including tools like Obsidian, Things, and remote-control utilities.

  • Safer External App Prompts: Unite now uses clearer confirmation behavior for external app links, with remembered choices and protection against repeated background launch attempts.

  • Window Titles in Dock Menus: Window titles now update correctly in the Dock icon right-click menu, making it easier to identify and switch between open windows.

  • Window Title Visibility Fixes: Fixed issues where window title visibility settings could become out of sync, including when toggling the title from the View menu.

  • NotebookLM Compatibility Fix: Fixed an issue where NotebookLM modules would fail to load correctly inside Unite apps.

  • Improved Anti-Bot Compatibility: Improved behavior on websites with anti-bot detection and security checks.

  • Updated User Agents: Updated built-in user agents for better compatibility with modern websites.

  • User Agent Preset Persistence: Fixed an issue where selected user agent presets could reset unexpectedly after Safari or macOS updates.

  • Default Zoom Persistence: Fixed an issue where the default zoom level could reset to 100% on launch when cross-app zoom sync was disabled.

  • Native Reload Improvements: Improved reload behavior so Unite apps reload pages more cleanly without leaving old background page contexts running.

  • Improved WebView Cleanup: Strengthened WebView teardown behavior to improve memory usage and reliability during reloads, mode changes, and app updates.

  • Bundle Restoration Fix: Fixed an issue with bundle restoration after Unite app updates.

  • Improved App Update Behavior: Fixed an issue where some tools could warn about Unite apps after an app update.

  • Text Editing Shortcut Improvements: Fixed issues where Cmd+Left and Cmd+Right could interfere with text editing in web fields, including apps like Google Chat.

  • Alternate Back and Forward Shortcut Fixes: Improved the Alternate Back/Forward shortcut setting so Cmd+Arrow navigation respects your preference while preserving expected text editing behavior.

  • Improved Delete Key Behavior: Improved delete key behavior while using media and interactive website controls.

  • Sidebar New Window Fix: Fixed an issue where creating a new window from a link context menu did not work correctly in Sidebar Mode.

  • Dock New Window Fix: Creating a new window from the Dock icon now works correctly in Sidebar Mode.

  • Tab Window Fixes: Fixed an issue where tabs could sometimes appear associated with the wrong window.

  • User Script Improvements: Improved user script persistence and reliability across sessions and websites.

  • Creation Tool Name Safety: Improved the creation tool so app names that could cause path issues are cleaned up automatically before creating an app.

  • Improved Overwrite Prompts: Improved the prompt shown when creating or saving an app that would overwrite an existing app.

  • License Validator Improvements: Improved warnings and behavior in the license validator.

  • License Info in About: License information now appears in the About box for easier reference.

Unite Pro 1.4
May 10, 2026
Download Unite Pro 1.4

  • Expanded Media Key Support: Improved media key support across significantly more websites, making play, pause, and other media controls work more consistently inside Unite apps.

  • Local HTML File Support: Added support for loading local file:// HTML URLs, expanding what Unite apps can open and run.

  • Improved ChatGPT Performance: Improved performance on chatgpt.com for a smoother and more responsive experience.

  • User Script Reliability Improvements: Improved user script persistence between sessions and sites, making scripts more reliable across repeated app launches.

  • User Script Management Fixes: Fixed an issue where user scripts could become duplicated or impossible to delete.

  • Sidebar Window Dragging: Sidebar windows can now be dragged from the top of the window, just like a normal macOS window.

  • Persistent Toolbar Visibility: The Show Toolbar setting now persists when Smart Toolbar is turned off, allowing you to keep the toolbar visible at all times if preferred.

  • User Agent Improvements: Improved user agent handling for better website compatibility across Unite apps.

  • Keyboard Shortcut Fixes: Fixed an issue where the Shift key would not work on certain websites because it was incorrectly captured by the shortcut listener.

  • Inspect Element Fix: Fixed a bug where Inspect Element could go blank after moving away from a tab.

  • App Update Compatibility Fix: Fixed an issue where tools like Little Snitch could warn about Unite apps after an app update.

  • macOS 15 Design Improvements: Improved Unite Pro’s design and visual consistency when running on macOS 15.

Unite Pro 1.1
March 23, 2026
Download Unite Pro 1.1

  • Tiny Apps: Unite normal windows can now be resized down to incredibly small sizes, making it easy to keep a persistent mini app on screen for dashboards, chat tools, timers, and other lightweight workflows.

  • External App Link Forwarding: Link forwarding now supports external app URL schemes like obsidian://, things://, and other app-specific links, allowing Unite apps to connect more naturally with the rest of your workflow.

  • Auto-Refresh Improvements: Auto-refresh is now significantly more powerful, with custom time intervals and the ability to begin refreshing only after a page has been idle.

  • Bookmark Reordering: You can now rearrange bookmarks directly in the bookmark bar and bookmark manager for more flexible organization.

  • Home Button Toolbar Support: The Home button can now be added back to the toolbar in Normal Mode through toolbar customization.

  • Improved Trust Certificate Flow: Unite Pro now handles website trust certificate prompts much more cleanly, eliminating repeated permission popups and persisting your decisions between sessions.

  • Improved Link Forwarding Reliability: Fixed an issue where forwarded links opened inside a Unite Pro app would not always route correctly to the intended destination.

  • Improved Link Forwarding Performance: Link forwarding is now faster and more responsive overall, especially when working with larger rule sets.

  • Improved App Importing: Updated the app importing backend to fix an issue where imported apps were not always signed correctly.

  • Improved App Editing Signing: Fixed an issue where edited apps were not being signed correctly after changes were made.

  • Improved Shortcut Initialization: Shortcut initialization and overall shortcut behavior have been refined to make keyboard controls more reliable across Unite apps.

  • Keyboard Shortcut Fixes: Fixed issues where some apps could open without certain shortcuts working, and resolved a bug where Cmd+Left and Cmd+Right would not behave correctly in text editors.

  • Improved Messenger Badge Behavior: Refined Facebook Messenger badge behavior to improve accuracy and consistency.

  • Improved PDF Preview Downloads: Fixed an issue where documents could not be downloaded from the PDF previewer.

  • Show in Browser Fix: Fixed an issue where the “Show in Browser” toggle was not working correctly during app creation.

  • Improved App Location Editing: Fixed an issue where app locations would not move correctly when edited to a new save location.

  • Improved URL Process Cleanup: Fixed an issue where Unite could create multiple URL processes for the same web view and fail to clean them up after the web view was closed.

  • Crash Fix for Update Search: Fixed an issue where Unite Pro could crash while searching for created apps to update.

  • Traffic Light Visibility Fix: Fixed an issue where hiding the macOS traffic lights could unexpectedly disable itself when the window was no longer key.

Unite Pro 1.0
March 9, 2026
Download Unite Pro 1.0

​Unite Pro is the biggest update in Unite’s history — completely rebuilt and reimagined for modern macOS. With an all-new creation experience, powerful customization tools, native macOS enhancements, and a refined interface built for macOS Tahoe, Unite Pro transforms the way websites work on your Mac. Faster, cleaner, and more capable than ever, this is the next generation of web apps on macOS.

​​​

  • All-New Creation Experience: A completely redesigned creation tool built for macOS Tahoe with a modern, native interface that makes turning a website into a Mac app effortless.

  • Intelligent App Setup: Automatically detects clean app names, high-quality icons, correct URLs, and sensible defaults so your app feels right from the first launch.

  • Beautiful Icon System: Improved favicon recognition with elegant macOS-style fallback icons and gradients when sites don’t provide one.

  • Default Preferences: Set your preferred app settings once and create multiple apps quickly without repeating configuration steps.

  • Three App Modes: Run every app in Normal, Sidebar, or Menu Bar mode — and switch instantly between them.

  • Redesigned Sidebar Mode: A fully rebuilt, resizable sidebar with improved support for pinned apps and persistent layouts.

  • Refined Menu Bar Mode: Cleaner design, improved shortcuts, and better window management for lightweight access.

  • Website Controls: Visually remove elements, adjust typography and color, force light or dark mode, disable sticky headers, and fine-tune readability directly inside your app.

  • Rebuilt Scripts & Styles Engine: A completely rewritten customization engine for user scripts and styles with improved reliability and precise per-URL targeting.

  • Automatic User Agent Switching: Set default user agents or automatically switch them based on site or specific paths.

  • Per-Site Zoom Levels: Define global or per-site zoom settings for consistent readability across every app.

  • Cross-App Sync: Optionally share scripts, styles, zoom levels, and user agent settings across your Unite apps.

  • Smart Enhancements: Native macOS capabilities layered onto supported websites for deeper system integration.

    • Badge Notifications: Display real-time dock and menu bar badges for supported services like Gmail, Slack, and more.

    • Meeting Notifications: Receive system-level alerts for Google Calendar and Outlook meetings with one-click access to join.

    • Video Speed Controls: Adjust playback speed granularly across most video websites with customizable shortcuts.

    • AI Companions: Access ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok anywhere on your system through a floating overlay.

  • Link Forwarding Improvements: Intelligently route links between Unite apps and your default browser with improved SSO handling and streamlined management.

  • Built for macOS Tahoe: A refined interface using modern system materials, beautiful light and dark modes, automatic menu bar icon tinting, and Apple silicon performance optimizations.

  • Enhanced Password Manager: Rebuilt for improved security and stability, with strong password generation, notes support, and easy import and export tools.

  • Location Manager: New per-site location controls let you grant and manage location permissions individually — a first for Unite.

  • Permissions Manager: View and manage notifications, camera, microphone, screen sharing, and location access per site from one centralized interface.

  • Download Manager: A redesigned, native download interface with improved previews and live progress tracking.

  • Dock Monitor: Display a live, updating view of selected website elements directly in your app’s dock icon.

  • Quick Settings: Instantly adjust zoom, user agent, ad blocking, and link forwarding without opening full preferences.

  • Shortcut Customization: Search and rebind keyboard shortcuts across your Unite apps.

  • Auto Dark Mode: Automatically convert light-only websites to dark mode for a consistent visual experience.

  • Built-In Ad Blocker: Improved reliability and cleaner browsing without relying on third-party extensions.
